title: Alif Semi Balletto B1 and Ensemble E1C StartKits feature Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55 MCU for IoT and Edge AI
summary: Alif Semiconductor s Ensemble E1C (SK-E1C) and Balletto B1 (SK-B1) StartKits are low-cost development boards built around the company s Cortex-M55 + Ethos-U55 microcontrollers. The Balletto B1 adds BLE 5.3 and 802.15.4 wireless connectivity, while the Ensemble E1C does not have built-in wireless connectivity. Both StartKits feature a microcontroller with a 160MHz Cortex-M55 CPU, an Ethos-U55 NPU, 2MB SRAM, and 1.8/1.9MB NVM. They also include an Arducam camera header, a mikroBUS Click Board expansion socket, and two PDM microphones for camera, audio, and sensor-based projects. The Balletto B1 additionally provides the complete RF path to a chip antenna for its wireless subsystem, while both boards feature an on-board Segger J-Link debugger for development and testing.
